blockingFindings.description: Direct inspection of all eleven current renders shows the overskirt side panels forming sharp triangular flaps in sit and crouch, with front/back fabric hanging between the legs. Standing front, back, left, right and three-quarter views retain repeated narrow side ridges and pointed outward hem corners. The V93 shorts shell has a more regular clipped leg opening, but its broad faceted surface remains prototype-quality.

The measured under-shorts upper-thigh coverage is 68.6% neutral, 64.2% crouch and 63.8% sit. These geometric coverage measurements do not establish a sewn garment, fit, collision clearance, or acceptable visual coverage.
The direct render set does not establish avatar fit, shape-key response, UV completion, Unity/VRChat runtime or customer release readiness. Keep all independent quality gates unchanged.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
